## Session Context (Notepad++ MCP)

You can automate Notepad++ on Windows: open/edit/save files, manage tabs and sessions, lint code, control plugins.

**Before starting work:**
1. Check editor state: status_ops(operation="health_check")
2. Inspect the active document: file_ops(operation="info")

**At end of work, persist state:**
- Save the workspace when asked: session_ops(operation="save", session_name="...")
- Run linting before declaring code done: linting_ops(operation="python", file_path="...")
